name: HEALTHBANE - MedDefense Coverage (post-4x03)
description: HEALTHBANE campaign ATT&CK coverage after completion of project 4x03 (malware triage). Combines intelligence-derived mappings from 4x02 with malware-confirmed techniques from 4x03 analysis of the dropper, RAT and exfiltrator. Source of truth for hunt-time gap analysis in 4x04.

techniques.comment: OBSERVED - 4x00 phishing dissection. 3 emails confirmed (meddefense-portal, outlook-protection, meddefense-benefits). Diane Marsh click 2026-04-14.
OBSERVED - 4x03 dropper analysis. HEALTHBANE_S2_invoice.docm requires user-enable-macros click.
OBSERVED - 4x03 exfiltrator sync_healthdata.ps1 is PowerShell.
OBSERVED - 4x03 dropper uses VBA macro (AutoOpen and Document_Open handlers).
OBSERVED - 4x03 RAT references HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run\HealthSync in sandbox report.
OBSERVED - 4x01 + 4x03. HTTPS beaconing to healthbane-c2.net:443 every ~5 min.
OBSERVED - 4x03 exfiltrator constructs DNS TXT queries to data-sync.healthbane-c2.net for data exfil (Stage 3 at partner orgs).
OBSERVED - 4x03 RAT implements RC4-like stream cipher for C2 payload wrapping before TLS (defense in depth against proxy inspection).
OBSERVED - 4x03 dropper base64+XOR-obfuscated VBA payload; exfiltrator script uses encoded command invocations.
OBSERVED - 4x03 exfiltrator uses -EncodedCommand PowerShell invocation form.
OBSERVED - 4x03 dropper decodes embedded payload at runtime (chr()+XOR chain).
OBSERVED - 4x03 dropper downloads svchost_update.exe from healthbane-c2.net/update/.
INFERRED - 4x03 exfiltrator has C2-upload code path. Not observed against MedDefense (Stage 3 did not execute here).
INFERRED - DNS exfiltration capability present in exfiltrator code. Not observed at MedDefense.
INFERRED - exfiltrator targets database file patterns and SELECT query outputs. Not observed at MedDefense in 4x03.
OBSERVED (attacker-side) - 4x00 WHOIS analysis confirmed newly registered lookalike domains.
OBSERVED - 4x00 classified 3 of 8 emails as spearphishing link.
NOT COVERED - PsExec/SMB admin shares. No detection, no observed evidence at MedDefense, not described in Stage 1-3 analysis. Listed as campaign-possible in HC3-2026-HEALTHBANE-001 but unconfirmed.
NOT COVERED - WinRM / PowerShell Remoting. No detection, no observed evidence.
NOT COVERED - WMI remote execution. No detection, no observed evidence.
NOT COVERED - LSASS memory dumping. Could not be confirmed by the 4x03 malware triage - the captured samples do not touch LSASS. Hypothesis for Stage 4.
INFERRED - Valid Accounts usage likely (stolen phishing credentials used for follow-on). Not yet confirmed beyond dmarsh credentials in 4x00.
NOT COVERED - Domain service account abuse. Hypothesis only.
NOT COVERED - Pass-the-Hash. No detection, no observed evidence.
NOT COVERED - Scheduled Task persistence. Not described in Stages 1-3, not in 4x03 samples.
NOT COVERED - Local Data Staging. Advisory mentions in Stage 3 at partner orgs but not in 4x03 samples observed at MedDefense.
NOT COVERED - Archive via Utility. Not in captured samples.
NOT COVERED - Clear Windows Event Logs. No detection, no evidence.
INFERRED - 4x03 sandbox shows Run-key registry write. Full scope of registry modification not mapped.
